name: The Foot of the Ascent
desc: Hub of Threshold and the door to the Ascent. Rest at the Doorstep Inn makes this the city haven: a lost fight returns you here. All eight district roads end here, 1 s each. The Warden of the Foot stands here and gives the starting quests.

name: The Lectory Steps
desc: Gate of the Scholars’ Quarter. Argue on the Steps trains Intelligence. Connects to the Foot, the Reading Hall, the Chalk Yard, the Granary Gate and the Pilgrims’ Stair.

name: The Reading Hall
desc: Indoor. Holds a Spell Table for inscribing spells. Read Until It Sticks trains Intelligence. Sit With a Hard Passage trains Wisdom and pays magic skill XP. Docent Marell stands here.

name: The Chalk Yard

finds.desc: 💰 A purse under the chalk working on the flagstones: 10 to 15 gold.

desc: Read the Old Working explores the yard (42 s). Copy Out a Proof trains Intelligence.

name: Pilgrims' Stair
desc: Gate of Temple Rise. Walk the Stair trains Constitution. Connects to the Foot, the Nine Chapels, Censer Walk, the Lectory Steps and the Muster Gate.

name: The Nine Chapels
desc: Indoor. Holds a Spellcrafting Table: its Divine tab teaches miracles for favor. Keep a Vigil trains Wisdom and pays magic skill XP. Prior Ashvane stands here.

name: Censer Walk
desc: Colonnade off the Pilgrims’ Stair. Work the Colonnade trains Charisma. Ilex stands here.

name: The Muster Gate
desc: Gate of the Ironyard. Drill in Formation trains Strength. Captain Hurst stands here. Connects to the Foot, the Cages, the Sand, the Long Gallery, the Pilgrims’ Stair and the Retort Gate.

name: The Cages

dare.desc: Oh dang, this slime’s gotten big. I don’t think you should tackle that, but if you wanna try yer luck, go ahead.

desc: Menagerie. Step Into a Cage fights one Forest Rat, Cage-Bred Slime or Goblin at a time (levels 1 to 3), never a rolled modifier. The slimes are bred with no armour or resistances. Kills here unlock each bestiary fact exactly at its kill count. The keeper heals beginners after every win.

name: The Sand
desc: Footwork on the Sand trains Dexterity. Spar trains Strength and pays combat skill XP. Beat the Post fights a wooden post that never strikes back: a tenth of the usual skill and attribute XP, less as each level rises, never under 1 XP per second for each skill and attribute it trains. Master Ekwe stands here.

name: The Long Gallery
desc: Indoor archery range. Shoot the Long Butts trains Dexterity; Draw Until It Hurts trains Constitution.

name: The Retort Gate
desc: Gate of Alembic Row. Sister Nim sells healing salve, mushroom broth, mendroot and spring water here. Connects to the Foot, the Alembics, the Vivarium, the Muster Gate and the Chancery Arch.

name: The Alembics
desc: Indoor, heat-tagged. Holds an alchemy bench. Wash Out the Retorts is a job: 11 gold per 21 s. Odri Venn sells reagents here.

name: The Vivarium
desc: Indoor. Holds a Culture Bench for geneshaping.

name: The Chancery Arch
desc: Gate of the Chancery. No activities. Connects to the Foot, the Rolls, the Seal Room, the Retort Gate and the Assize Gate.

name: The Rolls
desc: Indoor. Copy Out Writs is a job: 12 gold per 22 s. Read the Indexes trains Intelligence.

name: The Seal Room
desc: Indoor. Learn Which Stamp trains Wisdom.

name: The Assize Gate
desc: Gate of the Assize. Watch a Case Argued trains Charisma. Connects to the Foot, the High Bench, the Holding, the Chancery Arch and the Wrights’ Gate.

name: The High Bench
desc: Indoor. Plead a Small Matter trains Charisma; Weigh Both Sides trains Wisdom.

name: The Holding
desc: Indoor. Stand the Night Watch is a job: 14 gold per 26 s.

name: The Wrights' Gate
desc: Gate of Wrights’ Ward. Pell Marrow sells armour and weapons here; four more lines open once the Toll Hall keeper is defeated. Connects to the Foot, the Forges, the Long Bench, the Assize Gate and the Granary Gate.

name: The Forges
desc: Heat-tagged. Smelting counter with the iron ingot recipe, and an anvil that forges ingots, hardwood and leather into pieces. Work the Bellows is a job: 14 gold per 25 s. Swing the Sledge trains Strength and pays blunt skill XP. Ferra Ostwind sells ore, scrap, wood and leather here.

name: The Long Bench
desc: Indoor. Holds a Rune Table for runecarving.

name: The Granary Gate
desc: Gate of the Granaries. Orrin Tallow sells rations and cooked dishes here. Connects to the Foot, the Granary Kitchens, the Weighbridge, the Undercrofts, the Wrights’ Gate and the Lectory Steps.

name: The Granary Kitchens
desc: Indoor, heat-tagged. Holds a Cooking Stove. Scrub the Pans is a job: 10 gold per 20 s. Bryva Coll sells raw ingredients here.

name: The Weighbridge
desc: Haul and Stack is a job: 11 gold per 18 s. Shift the Heavy Lots trains Strength.

name: The Undercrofts

finds.desc: 🌾 A split sack in the back stores: 3 Rough Flour.

desc: Indoor. Go Through the Back Stores explores the cellars (52 s). Shift Barrels All Day trains Constitution.

name: The Flooded Landing
desc: Landing of floor 1, the Flooded Offices. Camp Above the Water is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven. The Vermin Hall is the only way on. Goal: take the toll stamp from the Toll Collector.

name: The Vermin Hall
desc: Drive Out the Vermin fights Forest Rats (levels 1 to 2), one at a time; Slimes (level 1) join after 4 wins. 6 wins clear the hall and open the way to the Records Passage.

name: The Records Passage
desc: Passage off the Vermin Hall. No activities. Leads to the Archive, the Staff Lockers and the Forms Store, each a search room. The clerk’s daybook is found by searching the Archive.

name: The Archive
desc: Search the Shelves (5 s) pays 1 common herb, 3 to 8 gold, or the clerk’s daybook (once per run, guaranteed by the 4th search). The daybook opens the Forms Store’s door to Office Reception.

name: Staff Lockers
desc: Search the Room (5 s) pays 1 iron scrap or 3 to 8 gold.

name: Forms Store
desc: Search the Room (5 s) pays 1 iron scrap or 3 to 8 gold. With the clerk’s daybook, Enter the Office Section leads to Office Reception.

name: Office Reception
desc: Search Beneath the Desk (4 s) finds the office key; the eight office doors stay locked until you have it. Each door is named for its room. The daybook gives the room order that leads to the Toll Collector; a wrong door sends you to another room.

name: The Registry
desc: Numbered drawers reach the ceiling. The water has carried their labels across the floor.

name: Scribe’s Office
desc: Form templates lie beneath a paperweight. A ruler projects from the drawer beside them.

name: The Auditor
desc: A validation ledger lies open beside a stack of rejected forms.

name: Break Room
desc: A bowl of wax apples sits between two empty cups.

name: Dispatch Office
desc: Pigeonholes cover the wall. Unsent envelopes cling to the table legs.

name: Records Office
desc: Copies of the same receipt hang from drying lines.

name: Supply Office
desc: Boxes of spare nibs stand on a stool above the water.

name: Toll Collector’s Office
desc: Arriving starts a fight that cannot be fled: the Toll Collector, level 4, alone. A heat spell blinds it, a cold spell removes its dodge and most of its armour, a lightning spell speeds up its attacks and hurts it; each lasts 8 s. Its kill gives the toll stamp and clears floor 1.

name: The Stairhead
desc: Landing of floor 2, the same building as floor 1, one storey up. Camp on the Landing is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven. The Long Hall starts here (2.5 s).

name: The Mail Carts
desc: First stretch of the Long Hall. Clear the Stretch fights Bound Ledgers and Filing Automatons (levels 3 to 4), one at a time; after 3 wins the way on down the hall opens and the stretch spawns no more fights. A door leads to the Cleared Office, where the tutor teaches.

name: The Cleared Office
desc: An office emptied out for training. The tutor here teaches two techniques for free: Gather (Neutral → Coiled), then Lunge (Coiled → Extended) once you know a way into Coiled. Work the Heavy Bag trains Strength.

name: The Filing Bays
desc: Second stretch of the Long Hall. Clear the Stretch fights Filing Automatons and Bound Ledgers (levels 4 to 5), at most two at a time; 3 wins open the way on. A door leads to the Quartermaster’s Cage.

name: The Quartermaster’s Cage
desc: A caged supply room. The quartermaster sells healing salve and food.

name: Copy Room Row
desc: Third stretch of the Long Hall. Clear the Stretch fights Sorting Automatons and Living Dolls (levels 5 to 6), at most two at a time; 3 wins open the way on. A door leads to the Break Room.

name: The Break Room

finds.desc: 💰 A petty-cash tin behind the mugs: 70 to 110 gold.

desc: A haven halfway down the hall: Sit Down for a While is a rest activity. Go Through the Cupboards explores the room (30 s) for one find.

name: The Far End
desc: Far end of the Long Hall. Clear the Stretch fights Living Dolls and Filing Automatons (levels 6 to 7), at most two at a time. The third win clears floor 2; the stretch then spawns no more fights.

name: The Stairwell Head
desc: Landing of floor 3, the top of the building’s stairwell. Camp on the Landing is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven. The Mail Room is off the landing; the next flight down opens once its floor plan is found there.

name: The Mail Room

finds.desc: 🗺️ A floor plan in a mail sack, the stairwell marked. The next flight down is open.
💰 An unclaimed parcel of coin: 60 to 90 gold.
✂️ A string anchor bolted under the sorting table, its line running down through the floor. Cut: the bureaucrat below loses a string (one level).

desc: Sort Through the Sacks explores the room (36 s) for three finds: the floor plan that opens the stairwell’s next flight, a purse, and one of the three string anchors the bureaucrat in the Hearing Room hangs from.

name: The Second Landing
desc: Second landing of the stairwell. Clear the Landing fights Living Dolls and Sorting Automatons (levels 6 to 7), one at a time; 2 wins and it spawns no more fights. The Archive Stacks are off the landing; the next flight down opens once their floor plan is found.

name: The Archive Stacks

finds.desc: 🗺️ A floor plan filed under the stairwell. The next flight down is open.
🏏 An oak club wedged between two shelves. A club deals bludgeoning damage, which the bureaucrat, a construct, takes more of.
✂️ A string anchor behind the end shelf. Cut: the bureaucrat below loses a string (one level).

desc: Search the Stacks explores the room (42 s) for three finds: the floor plan for the next flight, an oak club, and a string anchor.

name: The Third Landing
desc: Third landing of the stairwell. Clear the Landing fights Living Dolls and Filing Automatons (levels 7 to 8), one at a time; 2 wins and it spawns no more fights. The Records Annex is off the landing; the way down to the Hearing Room opens once its floor plan is found.

name: The Records Annex

finds.desc: 🗺️ A floor plan with the Hearing Room marked at the bottom of the stairwell. The way down is open.
🧴 Two healing salves in a first-aid drawer.
✂️ The last string anchor, in the annex ceiling. Cut: the bureaucrat below loses a string (one level).

desc: Go Through the Files explores the room (42 s) for three finds: the floor plan to the Hearing Room, two healing salves, and the last string anchor.

name: The Hearing Room
desc: Bottom of the stairwell. Arriving starts a fight that cannot be fled: the Puppet Bureaucrat, alone. It is level 12 with all three strings, one level less for each string anchor cut in the side rooms above (level 9 with none left). Its kill clears floor 3; the room then spawns no more fights.

name: The Treeline
desc: Landing of floor 4, where the tower opens onto woodland. Camp at the Treeline is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven.

name: The Woods Edge

finds.desc: 🌿 Four common herbs under the leaf litter.
🫐 Four handfuls of forest berries.
💰 A purse dropped by a goblin scout: 30 to 60 gold.

desc: Endless hunt: forest rats, young wolves and goblins, level 7 to 9 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs), sometimes two at once. Forage explores the edge (24 s) for herbs, berries and a purse.

name: The Barrow Hills

finds.desc: ⛏️ Three chunks of copper ore in a cut bank.
⚱️ A looted barrow the looters missed a corner of: 50 to 90 gold and two iron scrap.

desc: Endless hunt: boars, cliff hawks and goblins, level 8 to 9 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Search the Barrows explores the hills (30 s) for copper ore and a barrow cache. Joins the Woods Edge and the Ravine Rim.

name: The Deep Woods

finds.desc: 🍄 Three cave mushrooms around a rotten stump.
⛺ An abandoned camp: 40 to 80 gold and two iron scrap.

desc: Endless hunt: wolves, boars and goblin raid parties of up to three, level 8 to 9 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Explore (30 s) finds mushrooms and an abandoned camp.

name: The Ravine Rim

finds.desc: 🪶 A hawk nest: 20 to 40 gold and a gold leaf.
🔭 Smoke on the ravine floor: the goblin raid camp. It is on the map.

desc: Endless hunt: cliff hawks and goblins, level 8 to 10 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Look Over the Edge (24 s) finds a hawk nest and spots the raid camp below. The path down leads to the Raid Camp.

name: The Raid Camp
desc: The raid camp. One fight, started when you choose: the Goblin Raid Leader (level 9) and two goblins. Killing the leader clears floor 4.

name: The Causeway
desc: Landing of floor 5, a plank causeway into the swamp. Camp on the Causeway is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven. Gate: 12 goblins killed in total.

name: The Bog

finds.desc: 🌿 Five common herbs on a dry hummock.
💰 A drowned purse: 50 to 90 gold.

desc: Endless hunt: water slimes, zombie slimes, goblin firetongues and goblins, level 9 to 10 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Firetongues cast fire that can set you On Fire. Wade the Bog explores (30 s) for herbs and a purse.

name: The Drowned Village

finds.desc: 🧴 Two healing salves in a hut that stayed dry.
💰 A goblin cache under the floorboards: 70 to 120 gold.

desc: Endless hunt: firetongues and goblins, level 9 to 11 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs), up to three at once. Search the Huts explores (30 s) for two healing salves and a cache. Joins the Bog and the Cave Mouth.

name: The Cave Mouth
desc: Endless hunt: hobgoblins, spider slimes and goblins, level 9 to 11 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Hobgoblins fight with techniques; with martial open, seeing one used on you 50 times teaches it.

name: The Hollows

finds.desc: ⛏️ Four chunks of copper ore in a seam.
🚪 A draught from a crack in the rock: a guarded door into the goblin warren. The way to the Back Door is open.
🔩 Four iron scrap from a broken cart.

desc: Dark: your dodge is cut by 25% and your attacks gain a 15% extra miss chance; Darkvision shrinks both, to nothing at level 50. Endless hunt: hobgoblins, spider slimes and stone golems, level 10 to 11 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Map the Hollows explores (36 s) for copper ore, the warren's back door and iron scrap.

name: The Back Door
desc: One fight, started when you choose: the Hobgoblin Champion (level 8) and one hobgoblin. Killing the champion clears floor 5.

name: The Warren Mouth
desc: Landing of floor 6, the goblins' warren. Camp at the Mouth is a rest activity, and the landing is a haven. Gate: 40 goblins killed in total.

name: The Tunnels
desc: Endless hunt: goblins, hobgoblins, firetongues and witch doctors, level 10 to 12 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs), up to three at once. Witch doctors heal their allies. Leads to the Pens, the Kitchens and the Shrine.

name: The Pens

finds.desc: 🥩 Four raw meat from the store pens.
🔓 The pens are open and the war boars gone into the tunnels. Sabotage: the warchief loses a level.

desc: Break Open the Pens explores (30 s) for meat and one of the three sabotages. Each sabotage takes a level off the warchief.

name: The Kitchens

finds.desc: 🍞 Three loaves from the goblins' stores.
🧪 The war band's stores are spoiled. Sabotage: the warchief loses a level.

desc: Foul the Stores explores (30 s) for bread and one of the three sabotages.

name: The Shrine

finds.desc: 💰 The shrine's offering bowl: 80 to 140 gold.
🔥 The shrine is overturned and its fire out. Sabotage: the warchief loses a level.

desc: Endless hunt: witch doctors and firetongues, level 11 to 12 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs). Desecrate the Shrine explores (30 s) for an offering and one of the three sabotages. The drop down to the deep encampment starts here.

name: The Drop
desc: The deep encampment, second map of the warren. Dark: your dodge is cut by 25% and your attacks gain a 15% extra miss chance; Darkvision shrinks both, to nothing at level 50. Camp in the Drop is a rest activity and a haven. Endless hunt: hobgoblins, witch doctors, firetongues and goblins, level 11 to 13 (up to double that while your attributes are higher than theirs), up to three at once.

name: The Great Hall
desc: Arriving starts a fight that cannot be fled: the Goblin Warchief and two escorts (witch doctors, firetongues or hobgoblins). The warchief is level 11 with no sabotage, one level less for each of the three (8 with all three). Killing it clears floor 6 and opens prestige.

name: The Holding Cell
desc: Floor 0, where a new life starts. Sleep on the Straw is a rest activity, so the cell is a haven. The rack here is the tutorial’s weapon choice. The cell door leads to the Cellblock (2 s).

name: The Cellblock
desc: Corridor outside the cell. Fight the Cell Slime is one fight: the slime deals 1 damage per hit and is gone once beaten. The yard door leads to the Field (3 s).

name: The Field
desc: Open ground between the cellblock and the gate. Fight in the Field holds three fights against Cell Slimes (levels 1 to 2), then spawns no more fights. Study the Gate Plaque trains Intelligence. The path leads to the Gate (3 s).

name: The Gate
desc: The way out of floor 0. The road through it into Threshold (3 s) is one-way: the Foot of the Ascent is on the other side and the floor closes behind you.
